acceptance: The K5 preflight reports the clean-boundary count for boundary.ratchet_merge.stage
fix: Add a scorer adapter for boundary.ratchet_merge.stage that counts clean boundaries (decision would_record or none, no refusal) from the signal center, and register it with the K5 flip path.
summary: AD4-4 (boundary.ratchet_merge.stage, shadow by default) records one CLI_RATCHET_MERGE_DECISION signal per boundary as its shadow evidence, but stageevidence.DefaultScorer does not read signals.ndjson, so the K5 flip after 3 clean boundaries has no scorer for this key.
title: The stage-evidence scorer reads CLI_RATCHET_MERGE_DECISION, so the ratchet record stage can flip on 3 clean boundaries
